scope: Every current Next page source audited, plus separate backend developer/careers portals. Source coverage is not a claim that every permission-sensitive or dynamic record was opened with production data.
preserved: Student home greeting and feature order
Single existing advertisement position and eligibility guards
School/app Korean and desktop platform/developer English
Existing APIs, membership authorization and personal/project data
verificationSafety: Browser actions used synthetic local fixtures. No real registrations, uploads, private SQL writes, deployments, mail, or GPU jobs were submitted. Production verification uses normal anonymous browsing and health/asset reads.
limitations: Some dynamic pages require valid record fixtures; invalid IDs are not content verification.
Feature-flag-disabled public routes remain disabled; a deliberate 404 is not reported as a successful content render.
Independent visual review does not prove WCAG compliance across all real user content.
A responsive improvement is not a measured conversion or revenue improvement.

audit.reason: Actual Next optimized f6ac8e5 build with matching 14000/14001 build/runtime ports: real Supabase JS and login form, strict portal session ID, school affiliation filters/search/clear, in-memory legacy approval/review actions and non-admin denial. Eight role/frame/theme cases pass. Forced app 503 now renders Korean; WebView and query-only desktop-UA app html lang are ko. Mismatched portal session ID blocks before account list reads or account patches. No external requests or real private writes. API responses are isolated mocks, not server-side authorization proof; multi-school flag is disabled in the demo. Earlier dev routeLoading did not reproduce in optimized builds.
Actual enabled analytics UI and GET report read verified in synthetic fixture; Korean labels keep original CONFIRMED API code and dates. No report import/experiment mutations.
Actual career inbox, expanded response, search no-match and retry error verified; desktop English/app Korean with applicant content preserved.
